title: Gintama
source: Gintama manga by Hideaki Sorachi (finished 2019), to the end of the final arc.
world: In an alternate Edo invaded by aliens called Amanto, swords are banned and samurai are a dying breed. Lazy, sweet-toothed ex-war hero Gintoki Sakata runs the Yorozuya, an odd-jobs business, with Shinpachi and the alien girl Kagura. Endless parody and silly comedy switch into serious arcs about his past in the Joui War and his teacher Shoyo. Absurd, heartfelt and fourth-wall-breaking.
power_system: No powers for humans; swordsmanship and grit. Amanto races (like Kagura's Yato) have superhuman strength.
